test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The old man was not only __infirm__ but also blind and was unable to move around by himself.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Robust". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Infirm** refers to someone weak or lacking physical strength, especially due to age or illness. (दुर्बल)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite his **infirm **body, the old poet’s spirit and passion for writing remained undiminished.
 
 
 
• **Robust **means strong and healthy; vigorous. (मजबूत)
 
 
• **Example: **The **robust **young athlete finished the marathon in record time.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diffident **means modest or shy because of a lack of self-confidence. (संकोची)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite her talents, she was **diffident **about her abilities and rarely spoke up.
 
 
 
• **Anaemic **refers to someone suffering from anaemia or lacking in colour, spirit, or vitality. (रक्ताल्पता)
 
 
• **Example:** After months of being unwell, she appeared somewhat **anaemic **and frail.
 
 
 
• **Hospitable **means friendly and welcoming to strangers or guests. (आतिथ्यपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The villagers were incredibly **hospitable**, making us feel at home during our visit.
